name: Extra Submarkets - Oddisz+Babylon ED.
author: Massacre
description: Adds the Gilgamesh Nebula, a hidden hub of stations with several stores: Elite, AI Ships, Weapon Bazaar and AI Core markets; Ship and AI Ship Procurement stations selling every hull (split by class); Ballistic/Energy/Missile arsenals selling every weapon (split by size); and a Fighter Hangar selling every wing (split by role). All procurement prices and every submarket can be toggled in the LunaLib settings menu.
